trial_court: Court of Civil Judge-06, (Central), Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi - CS SCJ No. : 2277/18
case_name: Icici Bank Ltd vs Abhishek Kumar Singh

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: ICICI Bank Limited, Through its Authorized Representative Sh. Mohit Grover
parties.respondent_defendant: Abhishek Kumar Singh, S/o Sh. Kailas Prasad Singh

facts_of_case: ICICI Bank Ltd filed a suit for recovery of Rs. 56,152/- against Abhishek Kumar Singh with the averments that defendant had defaulted in repayment of loan amount and interest.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the defendant to prove that the loan was not utilized for the intended purpose.
legal_principles.held: Considering, the persistent defaults of the defendant in paying the EMI's, the plaintiff bank was constrained to file the present suit for the recovery of Rs.59,533/- from the defendant.

legal_principles.principle: A plaintiff bank can file a suit for recovery of loan amount when the defendant defaults in repayment.
legal_principles.held: When after several requests and reminders to the defendant for payment of loan amount, the plaintiff bank was compelled to serve notice dated 15.03.2018 to the defendant recalling/foreclosing the entire loan agreement...

outcome.final_order: The final court order was to recover the amount of Rs. 56,152/- along with interest @ 23% P.A.
